what: Hovering over button or menu text makes the original text swell to 1.15x and vanish, while an identical copy stacked in the same spot rises from .8x to full size in .3s — the text changes like taking a breath. Not applied on touch devices

options.--fx-to: Scale factor the fading text grows by, default 1.15
options.--fx-from: Starting scale of the appearing text, default .8
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text box — inside Text, data-twin has the same text (required)

from.where: shared.css a:has([data-duplicate]) — header menu · dropdown rows · all pill buttons · magnetic buttons · ”See more” (only above 1025px)
